subject: DeepSeek Harness desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 (Windows installation)
method: Static inspection only: read the asar header/file table and embedded package manifests as text from resources/app.asar. The application was never launched, no GUI session was attached, no user profile or credential store was read.

autoInitializedProfiles.evidence: Embedded README text in the bundled launcher
autoInitializedProfiles.quotedText: The `web`, `headless`, `sdk`, `sdk-minimal`, and `acp` profiles auto-initialize on first use from shipped templates.

interpretation: The desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 distribution ships the ACP stack (dsh-acp, dsh-acp-app and @agentclientprotocol/sdk) together with an auto-initializing acp profile template, which the separately installed CLI 0.1.1-rc.2 does not. This establishes a distribution boundary between the two installs. Runtime behavior of the desktop ACP surface was NOT exercised in this run (launching the GUI is out of scope), so desktop ACP capability is recorded as present-in-distribution but not-verified, not as verified.
